What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `hash2`: Boost.Hash2 1.92: its headers (boost/hash2/) state no constant-time property.

The default of `digests::sha3_224`, `digests::sha3_256`, `digests::sha3_384`, `digests::sha3_512`, `digests::shake_128` and `digests::shake_256`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links (<<hash-default-backend>>).
